newsitem.title: LATVIA: NEW MEMBERS PROPOSED FOR SECURITIES COMMISSION.
newsitem.headline: NEW MEMBERS PROPOSED FOR SECURITIES COMMISSION.

text.p: Three new members have been proposed for markets watchdog the securities commission and were approved by the budget and finance committee on Tuesday, parliament officials said.

The new proposed commission board members are Valdis Dvinskis, a senior official with the Unibanka Ridzene branch, Andris Deninsh, head of the VEF company and Sarmite Jegere, former state investment and credit policy minister and currently assistant professor at the Turiba study centre.
The proposed board members have now to be approved by parliament at a plenary session.
One politician said the members were agreed on after consultations between the leading political parties and that they were expected to be approved by MPs.
Parliament has twice rejected proposed board members.
